obs: "Another argument on which indictments of this character have been sustained by some of the Circuit Courts is, that a reasonable construction must be given the statute... and therefore unreasonable to hold that Congress intended not to allow a decent writing in an obscene envelope, but at the same time to allow obscene writing in a proper envelope."

"Judicial perception that a particular result would be unreasonable may enter into the construction of ambiguous provisions, but cannot justify disregard of what Congress has plainly and intentionally provided."
